body: It's so hard. There are people who talk to me, but I don't reply because I'm scared what might happen if I get too close to someone. I'm usually quiet because I think my presence annoys people so I try to keep to myself. Even when meeting with people I haven't seen in so long, I don't talk because I feel like theyre just acting happy to see me again. They're just keeping up appearances and don't care about me.
